Captured 2026-11-09 using three newly created non-namespaced Developer scratch orgs, each with 30-day duration, from campaign Dev Hubs. Two orgs use the identical plain Developer scratch definition; the third uses the retained Communities feature plus enableNetworksEnabled definition from standard_profile_inventory/configurations/communities_feature/project-scratch-def.json. All three orgs were deleted, and each ScratchOrgInfo.Status was subsequently queried through its Dev Hub and returned Deleted.

The retained project is synthetic and repeats the original standard_profile_inventory and email_services_metadata queries. Before deployment only, the runAsUser placeholder in the email metadata was replaced with the owned scratch user's username. All class metadata was pinned to the indicated source_api before each deployment; each query was then run three times anonymously and as a deliberately failing @IsTest transport. The named tests separately exercise the administrator and a synthetic Standard User via System.runAs, and both explicit with-sharing and without-sharing wrappers. Anonymous execution uses the scratch administrator. The probe emits only profile names/license labels, synthetic email metadata, generated domain label lengths, lowercase and suffix; no generated domain, user name or ID is retained.

Each org_shape/phase/API row group records its exact setup: baseline has only the original two email services; redeploy repeats that deployment; extra_metadata adds the six synthetic functions in variants/extra_emailservices; settings_toggle enables Communities settings after extra metadata in the first plain org. plain2 repeats baseline and redeploy in the second plain org. Deployments and test classes use APIs 62.0 and 67.0. Variants/window_controls_initial compares Profile LIMIT 1 through 8 with its full sorted prefix, descending and non-null controls, UserLicense, PermissionSet, email setup objects, and three synthetic Account rows (created under savepoint then rolled back). variants/window_controls adds comparisons with minimum and maximum Profile ID without emitting IDs. Each control is observed three times in anonymous and named-test routes at both APIs in each org. Row phases window_controls and profile_id_controls distinguish these two probe versions.

Original conflicts retained at standard_profile_inventory/org.tsv:11 and standard_profile_inventory/limit-ordering-recheck.tsv:2, and at email_services_metadata/org.tsv:2 and email_domain_recheck/org.tsv:2. These originals were non-namespaced, as are the new controls; managed namespace is not an observed differing factor in either conflict. Two plain orgs isolate org identity from org shape; feature versus setting phases isolate Communities provisioning; extra_metadata isolates the visible setup data set; repeated calls isolate API, route, sharing, user and redeployment. No received mail is sent or delivered.

Representative command forms, run from temporary copies of project/:
  sf org create scratch --target-dev-hub <campaign-hub> --definition-file <retained-definition> --duration-days 30 --wait 10 --json
  sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app --target-org <owned-scratch> --api-version <62.0-or-67.0> --wait 10 --json
  sf apex run --target-org <owned-scratch> --file <synthetic-observer.apex> --api-version <62.0-or-67.0> --json
  sf apex run test --class-names <synthetic-test-class> --target-org <owned-scratch> --synchronous --result-format json --api-version <62.0-or-67.0> --wait 10 --json
  sf org delete scratch --target-org <owned-scratch> --no-prompt --json
The observer serializes the retained probe's output to debug; named tests deliberately assert false to transport CAPTURE JSON. The recorded org.tsv preserves native observations and excludes aliases, IDs, usernames, scratch hostnames and credentials.
